scope: Visible vanilla armor, shirts, tabards, shields and weapons; includes unused/developer entries present in the database. Server custom items are not included.

unobtainable.method: Explicit developer, NPC, test, placeholder and retired-item name markers. Missing acquisition records alone do not classify an item; uncertain items remain in normal rarities.

quest_minimum_level.method: Lowest quest MinLevel among every fixed or choice reward source, only for bind-on-pickup equipment with no equip level requirement. Quest-supplied items and known loot, vendor, starter, conversion or script-created alternatives are excluded. ItemLevel and recommended QuestLevel are not eligibility requirements; unknown sources receive no inferred restriction.
